title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48‑hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd‑party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World‑class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.

  • Stay current with learning trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in instructional design and workforce development.
  • Design assessments, quizzes, and evaluation strategies aligned with measurable learning outcomes.
  • Apply adult learning principles, learning science theories, and user experience best practices to all solutions.
  • Conduct usability testing, gather learner feedback, and iterate designs for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure learning materials meet accessibility standards and follow organizational branding.

Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or program evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design frameworks, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience designing and developing training content aligned with learning objectives and organizational needs.
  • Proficiency with e‑learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, and Adobe Captivate.
  • Familiarity with graphic design and multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or Camtasia.
  • Ability to create simple visual assets, animations, or interactive elements using tools like Canva, Vyond, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted learning design tools to support efficiency and innovation in training development.
  • Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint for designing instructor‑led content, visual layouts, and prototypes.
  • Solid foundation in learning science and the ability to design engaging, learner‑centered content across digital, instructor‑led, and blended delivery formats.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn to challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, we invest heavily in talent development and provide world‑scale projects with significant capital and technology investment.

Aramco energizes the world economy with one of the largest hydrocarbon producer portfolios and a commitment to enhance value to society. Join to apply for the Social Media Brand Strategist role at Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a Social Media Brand Strategist for a new venture within Toptal, you will work directly with the General Manager and the Operations Director to onboard, coach, and accelerate the growth of our Content Creator users. You will join an execution-driven team building a new business unit from zero. Your mindset must be that of a builder, not just a coach.

This role has two core missions:

  • Deliver hands‑on creator growth: You will coach creators 1‑to‑1 to grow their audience, increase their engagement, and monetize their content. You will analyze their entire content plan end‑to‑end. You will challenge them with personalized weekly tasks that improve key metrics such as click‑through‑rate, retention rate, followers growth, and engagement rate. Once creators reach strong traction, you will also identify new revenue opportunities and activate brand deals.
  • Build the foundations of the Creator Agent function: As our first full‑time Social Media Brand Strategist, you will design, test, and refine the methodologies that power our coaching model. You will transform your learnings into structured playbooks, training materials, and repeatable processes that will allow us to scale a high‑performing agent team.

This is not a passive coaching position. You will think like a strategist, operate like a creator, and build like an early‑stage founder. You must be able to analyze performance data, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

The ideal candidate is a senior creator strategist with real, proven experience growing accounts on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok. You understand how content scales, why packaging matters, and how to push creators to become consistent, professional, and commercially ready.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Conduct creators onboarding, assess performance, and identify growth opportunities across platforms.
  • Provide 1‑to‑1 coaching focused on improving content strategy, packaging, and execution (from scripting to community building).
  • Define weekly goals and metrics that drive measurable growth.
  • Guide creators toward professional publishing standards and consistent audience development.
  • Support creators in preparing for monetization and activate brand opportunities when appropriate.
  • Design, test, and refine the coaching methodologies that will scale the Creator Agent function.
  • Convert insights into structured playbooks, templates, and training materials for future agents.
  • Partner with the Operations Director to strengthen creator success processes and growth frameworks.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and partnerships teams on creator‑facing initiatives.
  • Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and best practices to update our approach continuously.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Proven experience growing social media accounts on YouTube, Instagram, and/or TikTok.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy fundamentals: ideation, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and retention, conversion, and community building.
  • Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience in roles that require coaching, advising, or client accountability.
  • Ability to break down creative work into structured frameworks and teachable steps.
  • Strong organizational discipline to manage around 10 creators weekly.
  • Availability to work in the Americas time zone.
  • Familiarity with creator monetization and brand partnerships is a plus.
  • Are a creator with +50k followers/subscribers on Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok.
  • Have monetized your own content through different sources, including brand deals, affiliate marketing, platform payouts, and selling products/services to your own audience.
  • Are familiar with doing paid social campaigns.

title: Volunteer System Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.
A day in the life
O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

Experiência com Excel

Sobre nós

Jaé é a plataforma de bilhetagem digital e mobilidade urbana do Rio de Janeiro. Nosso propósito é transformar a experiência de quem utiliza o transporte público, trazendo simplicidade, praticidade e inovação para o dia a dia das pessoas. Com tecnologia própria e serviços de qualidade, oferecemos soluções seguras e acessíveis, que vão desde o pagamento digital de passagens até a gestão integrada de modais. Buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente e fazer parte dessa mudança na mobilidade da cidade.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar análises exploratórias e estatísticas; interpretar dados e gerar insights;

  • Extrair, tratar e consolidar dados em múltiplas fontes (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) e escrever consultas SQL complexas;

  • Experiência com Python para análise e tratamento de dados (pandas, automações, ETL simples);

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação para explicar insights e análises.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com algum serviço de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP);
  • Conhecimentos básicos em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, Elastic);
  • Familiaridade com Git e metodologias ágeis;
  • Certificações em Power BI, SQL ou Data Analytics.

description:
(Banco de Talentos) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Outbound) - Vaga Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) | Presencial/RJ

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica ( ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de 09h às 18h | Escala: 5x2 (segunda a sexta) com eventuais escalas aos sábados (opcional).

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

title: Coordenador(a) de Logística | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Buscamos um profissional com forte capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e experiência em gestão de operações logísticas. Será responsável por garantir a fluidez dos fluxos de transporte (inbound e outbound), equilibrando eficiência operacional, nível de serviço e custo logístico.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir o fluxo de transportes inbound e outbound em nível nacional;
  • Controlar e evoluir os principais indicadores logísticos (OTIF, lead time, custo por entrega, etc);
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLA's junto às transportadoras e parceiros logísticos;
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe operacional;
  • Identificar oportunidade de melhoria contínua;
  • Otimizar fretes e rotas;
  • Apoiar na seleção, negociação e gestão de fornecedores de transportes;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica com as áreas da Companhia (Comercial, Planejamento Estratégico, Customer Service);
  • Garantir a excelência no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Realizar a negociação de prazos e valores de frete;
  • Otimizar os custos logísticos sem comprometer o nível de serviço;
  • Liderar iniciativas de eficiência de transporte em um ambiente dinâmico e em crescimento;

  • Experience in team management.
  • Proven self‑motivation, self‑direction, and eagerness to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
  • Intermediate English knowledge: the position may require eventual interaction with international stakeholders living in Brazil and abroad.
  • Distinctive problem‑solving ability – to break down ambiguous problems, put structure and use data‑driven insights to solve them.
  • Clear communication – you are a clear and concise communicator with the ability to synthesize a lot of information quickly and highlight the key insights.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software tools and working in a business with constant changes.

You’ll love working at DiDi because

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups – 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

ontem, hoje e sempre Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

pensamos sempre grande A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Construímos o Pagar.me em 2014 para mudar a forma de receber pagamentos pela internet. Nos tornamos uma empresa do grupo Stone Co. e atuamos para ajudar lojistas de todos os tamanhos e modelos de negócio, desde pequenas lojas e startups a grandes e-commerces e marketplaces, a possuir uma estrutura de pagamentos digital poderosa e flexível.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Job description

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar de forma analítica e proativa no processo de pré-cobrança e cobrança de órgãos públicos, garantindo que as faturas futuras estejam aptas para pagamento e que os débitos vencidos sejam negociados com eficiência. E que possa contribuir para a redução da inadimplência e para a melhoria do fluxo de recebíveis da Light, por meio de relacionamento estruturado, articulação com stakeholders internos e externos e aplicação de soluções estratégicas adequadas ao perfil de cada órgão.

Main responsibilities

Seus principais desafios serão:

  1. Monitorar faturas a vencer, assegurando que cada uma esteja devidamente atestada , possua previsão orçamentária e disponibilidade financeira para pagamento pelo órgão público;
  2. Identificar, registrar e acompanhar eventuais impeditivos que possam atrasar a liquidação, atuando proativamente na articulação com áreas internas e com o órgão para sua resolução;
  3. Manter controle atualizado dos fluxos e prazos de todos os documentos, aprovadores e rotinas de pagamento dos órgãos públicos atendidos;
  4. Realizar a cobrança de faturas vencidas, adotando abordagens estratégicas de acordo com o perfil de cada órgão inadimplente;
  5. Conduzir negociações para acordos de pagamento, propondo alternativas adequadas, alinhadas às diretrizes internas da Light;
  6. Acompanhar os desdobramentos das negociações, garantindo que compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos;
  7. Estabelecer relacionamento contínuo e profissional com representantes dos órgãos públicos, atuando como ponto focal de informações sobre faturamento e cobrança;
  8. Articular soluções e alinhamentos junto a áreas internas (comercial, jurídico, financeiro, atendimento, faturamento etc.) para eliminar entraves e viabilizar pagamentos;
  9. Elaborar relatórios periódicos de controle de pré-cobrança, inadimplência, negociações e previsão de recebimentos;
  10. Monitorar indicadores da carteira (ex.: aging, risco de inadimplência, tempo médio de pagamento) e propor ações preventivas e corretivas;
  11. Registrar todas as interações, tratativas e justificativas nos sistemas corporativos, garantindo rastreabilidade e integridade da informação;
  12. Atuar em conformidade com procedimentos internos e regulatórios aplicáveis ao setor elétrico e ao relacionamento com órgãos públicos;
  13. Contribuir com melhorias de processos e boas práticas, visando aumentar eficiência, previsibilidade e qualidade das entregas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Pacote Office avançado, com foco em Excel.

Additional information

  • Vale Refeição;

  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

description:
Join to apply for the INSTRUMENTADOR CIRÚRGICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Enfermagem
  • Curso Técnico em Instrumentação Cirúrgica Completo
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. title: Regional Compensation & Benefits Partner, LATAM
description:
REGIONAL COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PARTNER, LATIN AMERICA

A family-owned company, bioMérieux has grown to become a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics . For more than 60 years and across the world, we have imagined and developed innovative diagnostics solutions to improve public health . Today, our teams are spread across 45 countries and serve 160 countries with the support of a large distribution network.
Come and join a family-owned global company with a long-term vision, and a human-centered culture.

Mission Overview

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will lead the Compensation & Benefits strategy for Latin America, ensuring internal equity, external competitiveness, and support for business transformation, while maintaining consistency with global practices, adapting to local needs, and maintaining an employee value proposition that remains consistent and attractive across Latin America.

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will report to the Sr. Director, Human Resources - Latin America.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Trend Monitoring
    • Stay updated on compensation and benefits practices in the region to maintain competitiveness.
    • Conduct and analyze external compensation surveys and market trends to develop innovative compensation initiatives and manage cyclical activities such as open enrollment
  • Bridge Between Global and Regional Teams and Business Leaders
    • Act as a liaison between the global compensation team and regional leaders, translating business needs into appropriate policies and programs.
    • Partner with managers to define compensation packages that ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
    • Train HRBPs and leaders on C&B practices, career ranges, and JA as a tool for dialogue and development.
    • Support Transformation Projects in the region (integrations, restructures, new businesses), ensuring pay/benefits structures enable change.
  • Data Management and Analysis
    • Ensure accurate and timely data for salary reviews, inflation, offers, benefits, and structural adjustments.
    • Support or coordinate the region’s participation in market surveys according to local practices.
    • Perform comprehensive audits to verify the accuracy, compliance, and integrity of compensation practices and data within the system of record
    • Ensure adherence to Job Architecture (families, streams, levels, profiles) as the foundation for pay structures, career paths, and communication.
    • Conduct ad-hoc reviews (turnover due to pay, attraction challenges, organizational changes) and recommend market positioning adjustments.
  • Benefits & Total Rewards
    • Map, benchmark, and optimize benefits packages (health, life, meal, transportation, mobility, wellness, retirement), balancing harmonization and local customization across Latin America.
    • Manage vendors and administrators (negotiation, SLAs, quality, employee experience) and lead flex benefits projects
  • Policy Communication and Implementation
    • Guarantee that global, regional, and Local policies are communicated and applied correctly, including merit cycles, inflation, benefits, promotions, and incentive programs.
    • Implement and develop Regional policies aligned with global practices.
    • Reviewed and validated the local policies, ensuring that they are aligned with the Global policies and strategies.
  • Support Global Compensation Philosophy
    • Contribute to the execution of global strategies, including short- and long-term incentive programs, equity plans, and process governance .
    • Lead the design and end-to-end management of compensation programs, including salary adjustments, inflation, bonuses, and rewards, benefits ensuring strategic alignment and compliance.

Studies & Experiences

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Psychology, or related; MBA/post-grad preferred.
  • Expected 8–12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, with multi-country LATAM exposure.
  • Expertise in Job Architecture, job evaluation/levelling, and market pricing with global providers.
  • Experience in managing pay structures, incentives (STI/LTI), mobility, benefits, and compensation analytics, and tools and benchmarks (Mercer, WTW, CompAnalyst), Excel/BI, HRIS/ERP systems.

Soft Skills

  • Analytical thinking & synthetic mindset
  • Leader by Influence
  • Team spirit and customer-oriented
  • Ability to work in a matrix environment with cross-cultural flexibility ;
  • Problem-solving and teamwork abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative & out-of-the-box thinker
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Leadership and communication – Assertiveness.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • ethics/confidentiality

Language

Fluent in Spanish and English. Portuguese will be a plus.

Working Conditions

This role could be a hybrid model or home office model.

Location

The position could be based in any subsidiary of Latin America, such as Brasil, México, Chile, Colombia and Argentina.

Main responsibilities

O profissional de vendas desempenha um papel crucial na condução e apoio aos distribuidores da Tirolez, garantindo que os produtos sejam distribuídos de maneira eficiente, garantindo o atingimento das metas propostas de acordo com a estratégia da Cia., este cargo envolve uma combinação de gestão de relacionamento, análise de mercado e implementação de estratégias comerciais.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Interface Principal: Atuar como a principal interface entre a Tirolez e os distribuidores, garantindo a comunicação eficaz e a implementação das estratégias da empresa.

  • Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e implementar planos estratégicos para aumentar a participação de mercado e a penetração dos produtos nos canais de distribuição.
  • Negociação de Acordos Comerciais: Negociar termos e condições com distribuidores, assegurando acordos que beneficiem ambas as partes e promovam o crescimento das vendas.
  • Elaboração e Gestão do JBP: Criar e gerenciar o Joint Business Plan (JBP), alinhando os objetivos do distribuidor com as metas da Tirolez.
  • Gestão de Contas Prioritárias: Focar na gestão de contas prioritárias, como supermercados e demais lojas do canal, bem como os clientes do canal Food Service, para garantir a visibilidade e a disponibilidade dos produtos.
  • Desenvolvimento de Campanhas: Planejar e executar campanhas promocionais e estruturais para aumentar a demanda dos produtos.
  • Análise de Eficácia: Monitorar e analisar a eficácia das campanhas promocionais, ajustando as estratégias conforme necessário para maximizar os resultados.
  • Coordenação de Atividades: Coordenar todas as atividades relacionadas à gestão do cliente, garantindo que as estratégias da Tirolez sejam executadas de forma eficaz pelos distribuidores.
  • Liderança de Discussões: Liderar discussões sobre nível de serviço, merchandising e novas oportunidades de mercado, promovendo a colaboração entre a Tirolez e os distribuidores.
  • Desenvolvimento de Equipes: Atuar como consultor no desenvolvimento das equipes de vendas dos distribuidores, oferecendo treinamento e suporte contínuo.
  • Capacitação de Líderes: Treinar supervisores, gerentes, vendedores e entregadores, desenvolvendo suas habilidades e conhecimentos para melhorar o desempenho geral.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs: Monitorar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à produtividade, custos, rentabilidade e nível de serviço.
  • Análise de Dados: Analisar dados de vendas e desempenho para identificar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria para o desenvolvimento da região.
  • Garantia de Qualidade: Representar a Tirolez em visitas aos distribuidores para garantir que os padrões de qualidade e segurança sejam mantidos.
  • Treinamento em Qualidade: Oferecer treinamento em qualidade e segurança para todas as áreas do distribuidor, assegurando a conformidade com as normas da Tirolez.
  • Reuniões Regulares: Realizar reuniões regulares de trabalho e resultados com os distribuidores, alinhando expectativas e elaborando planos de ação.
  • Influência Estratégica: Influenciar a estruturação do negócio do distribuidor com base nas diretrizes estratégicas da Tirolez, promovendo melhores práticas e eficiência operacional.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Acadêmica: Administração de empresas ou áreas correlatas; certificação em vendas ou marketing será um diferencial;
  • Experiência: Vivência com vendas, vivência com clientes de médio e grande porte.
  • Conhecimentos/Habilidades: Informática (MS Office), Ferramenta de Dados (Mtrix, Scanntech, etc).

  • Proativo com foco em resultados e gestão de prioridades, alta capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão estratégica,

Join to apply for the Insurance Manager role at FIFA Women's World Cup

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working alongside FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Application Deadline: 2 June 2025

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. The Insurance Manager will also serve as the local contact for Insurance Brokers.

All tasks should be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed, with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor appropriate local insurance solutions (Personal, Property Damage, Business Interruption, Marine Cargo & Liability insurances) for all FWWC 2027 entities.
  • Advise and monitor insurance requirements for Host Cities, Stadium Owners, and Training Site Owners, ensuring timely implementation.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams to ensure all contracts with sponsors, suppliers, and contractors include adequate insurance clauses, indemnities, and warranties.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor an insurance manual and claim administration policies for stakeholders.
  • Manage claims (Personal, Property, Liability), recording, administering, and reporting them, and coordinating with the FIFA Lead Insurance, brokers, and insurers.
  • Serve as the insurance interface for all internal and external stakeholders of FWWC 2027.
  • Identify and evaluate potential risks, proposing countermeasures.
  • Support the implementation of a local risk management program.

Our DNA

  • Ambition – We are guided by excellence, we push for progress and not perfection;
  • Connection – We believe that people are the real drive of our company;
  • Global Mindset – We value diversity and believe that we are enriched by it;
  • Ownership – We take responsibility for our actions.

Position overview

As a Financial Specialist, you will hold a pivotal role within the company, overseeing a wide range of financial activities and contributing significantly to its financial health and efficiency.

Responsabilities

  • Bank Reconciliation: Perform the comparison and adjustment between the company’s financial records and bank statements to ensure transaction accuracy.
  • Cash Flow Management: Monitor and manage the cash flows of the offices for which you are responsible.
  • Accounts Payable: Support the company’s bill payment process, ensuring that bills are paid on time and in accordance with established financial policies.
  • Accounts Receivable: Manage and support activities related to the collection of amounts owed to the company by clients, aiming to maximize cash flow.
  • Financial Project Creation: Develop strategic financial projects to optimize resource management and maximize the company’s financial performance according to the area’s demand and office’s current needs.
  • Direct Assistance to the Front Office: Provide direct financial support to front office areas, offering relevant financial insights and analyses.
  • Team and Individual Goal Management: Define and monitor goals for both teams and individuals in the front office, aiming to improve performance and results and correlating them with costs.
  • Monitoring of Operational and Budgetary Costs: Closely monitor the company’s operational costs and compare them with annual budget lines to ensure financial control and efficiency.
  • Analysis of Accounting Documents and Correlation with Financial Analyses: Analyze accounting documents and link them to broader financial analyses to gain insights into the company’s financial health and identify areas for improvement.
  • Analysis of Accounting Documents and Integration with Financial Analyses: Analyze accounting documents and link them to broader financial analyses to gain insights into the company’s financial health and identify areas for improvement.
  • Results Meeting Presentations and Weekly Cash Management Monitoring: Prepare and present results reports in meetings, as well as conduct weekly cash management reviews, providing crucial information for decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering or related field;
  • Proven experience as a Financial Analyst or similar role, preferably in a multicultural environment;
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel;
  • Intermediate proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI) is a plus;
  • Advanced level of English is a must. Spanish is a plus;
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a keen attention to detail;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams;
  • Motivation to work in a multicultural environment;
  • Ability to handle confidential information.

What we offer

  • Performance bonus;
  • Meal Voucher and Grocery voucher (VA and VR);
  • Totalpass;
  • LifeInsurance;
